protocol.onset_detector: First absolute sample difference above0.001 times local peak, search1.49–1.56s;0.003 sensitivity probe
protocol.lag_policy: Selected once from the training-note onset of the preliminary candidate; same lag for baseline/candidate and both recipe variants. No validation event changed.
protocol.gain_policy: One RMS gain per entire recording, fitted only on hardware1.5–1.9375057s against candidate[t+sharedlag]; frozen on all other events
protocol.trajectory_age_correction: Subtract observed capture alignment and known93-sample renderer latency before mapping the existing linear envelope
protocol.interpretation: End-to-end audio evidence; residual envelope/output errors remain separate from damping. No per-note gain or event fitting, EQ, warp or waveform-phase matching.
protocol.audio_evaluation_guard: Start=max(segment start,-lag); end=min(segment end,render length-lag). Measure each segment separately, without concatenation.
protocol.harmonic_measurement: 80 ms windows at offsets 0.10,0.18,0.26,0.34 after the original MIDI timestamps; same shared lag applied to renderer. H2-H8 and H9-H16 measured where original hardware harmonic/H1 exceeds -45 dB. Overlapping observations are diagnostic samples, not independent statistical replicates.
protocol.metadata_audit_correction: The captured preliminary run_dry.py description lists FF54 as omitted, but authoritative renderer manifests show only FF20=00 omitted. FF54=2000000000 remains recorded metadata. Notes explicitly use channel 1; all note events and timing are preserved.
